fato_historico: 1914: Mexican Revolution: The last of U.S. forces withdraw from Veracruz, occupied seven months earlier in response to the Tampico Affair.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests that this is a beautiful time to release old burdens and find closure. Much like a period of withdrawal and peaceful departure, you may find that letting go of past conflicts allows fresh energy to enter your spirit. Consider this a season to anchor your heart in serenity and embrace the healing tides flowing your way.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in the grace of letting go and moving forward.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of change and finding emotional stability.
conselho: Trust your intuition and allow yourself to gently drift toward calmer, brighter waters today.
